direction.name: The dark room
direction.idea: One dark field from top to bottom, and in it, lit things. Photographs and objects appear like exhibits in a dim gallery: each with space around it, each the brightest thing on its screen. Type is light, small and sparse. The darkness is not a theme switch; it is a room, and the page is a slow walk through it. It suits subjects sold on atmosphere and material: an evening restaurant, a metal card, a record, a house at dusk.
direction.composition: A single near-black or deep-toned ground runs the full page with no section bands. First screen: either the name at full width in a light weight along the bottom edge with one dim photograph above it, or one object or photograph centred at 40–50% of the viewport with a line of text beneath at 16–18px. Each later screen holds one or two lit items at a generous size (the main one 40–60% of the screen width) with its text set beside it at full reading size; the darkness frames the items, it does not replace content. Images vary in size but all share the same darkness at their edges so they sit in the ground without frames. Practical details come last in a simple two-column text block. The only solid light element on the page is the single primary action.
direction.typography: Light or regular weights; they glow on dark. Avoid heavy bold, which looks cheap on black. Headings 4–7vw at most; text 16–18px with leading 1.6 and a slightly lifted ink (not pure white).
direction.colour: A dark ground with a tint (blue-black, green-black, brown-black), a soft light ink, a dimmer ink for secondary text, and one warm or bright accent used once per screen at most.
direction.imagery: Low-key photographs: dark backgrounds, one light source, subjects emerging from shadow. Their dark edges should blend into the page ground.
direction.photoTreatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.
direction.richness: Light against dark, and the slow pacing.
direction.pitfalls: Grey text on black fails contrast quickly: check it. No glow effects, no neon accent, no coloured light blobs. A dark page with a bright busy photograph is not this direction; choose low-key images. Dark does not mean empty: every screen still carries its content at a readable size, and running text is a light ink at 7:1 or more, not a dim grey.

hero.name: Lit strip, four corners
hero.blueprint: One near-black field with a single lit band. Four small pieces of text at 14px, medium weight, sit in the corners on 72px side margins and 44px top and bottom margins: the name top-left, one link top-right, one sentence saying what this is bottom-left (max 36ch), the single action as a text link bottom-right. Across the vertical middle runs one horizontal strip of photographs, 34vh tall (about 300px), each at its natural width with 10px gaps and square corners: eleven or more frames in a flex row wider than the viewport, so the first and last visible frames are cropped by the left and right edges. The frame nearest the centre is at full brightness; the others sit at filter: brightness(0.55) and brighten on hover or as they reach the centre. Under the centred frame, aligned to its left edge, its title is set in the same 14px text. The top quarter and the bottom quarter of the screen stay empty and dark. The strip scrolls sideways with overflow-x: auto and scroll-snap; never hijack vertical scroll.
hero.mobile: The strip stays a single sideways-scrolling row but grows to 46vh tall, so one frame and the cropped edges of its neighbours fill the width. The name and the link sit at the top on 20px margins; the sentence and the action stack bottom-left under the strip at 14px. Dark space remains above and below the strip, about 12% of the height each.
hero.headline: None at display size: the name at 14px in a corner and one sentence of up to 60 characters.

type.note: Hairline serif capitals set large enough that the thin strokes read as drawing, with a small neutral sans for everything practical. Suits lodges, spas, architecture and interiors; keep it on flat pale or dark fields where the strokes have full contrast.

palette.name: Graphite and orange
palette.note: Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate, graphite taking about two thirds, and photographs are desaturated so nothing competes. Safety orange marks the buttons, one thick solid bar across the top of the page and the highlighted item in a list or chart.

motion.name: Drag row
motion.description: A row of large items wider than the screen that the visitor pulls sideways: native horizontal scrolling with scroll snapping, the first item aligned to the page margin and the last allowed to run off the edge so the row visibly continues. No carousel library, no arrows, no dots.

sections.name: Staircase statement
sections.blueprint: On a flat dark or saturated field one sentence of 12–18 words is broken into five short lines at clamp(36px, 4.4vw, 64px), bold, leading 1.02, marked up as one paragraph (a statement, so it may run past two lines at this size). Each line starts further right than the one above: indents of 0, 6, 12, 18 and 24vw from a 4vw left margin, set with `padding-left` per line, so the block descends like stairs and ends near the 75% mark. Each line takes its own flat colour from the palette, or lines alternate between two inks. The block is vertically centred in a section 100svh tall. The right quarter (columns 10–12) holds two stacked photographs, each 3:2 and 20vw wide with a 16px gap, top-aligned with the first line. No heading; a two-line note at 15px sits at the bottom-left margin, on the first line's left edge. On a page without images, leave the right quarter empty.
sections.mobile: Five lines at 9vw (35px on a 390px screen) with indents of 0, 5, 10, 15 and 20vw, so the stair still reads on a 390px screen. The two photographs follow below as one row of two equal 3:2 frames. The note sits last, left-aligned.

sections.name: One frame, three distances
sections.blueprint: A wrapper 300vh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh. On the stage one frame is centred: 30vw wide at 4:5, square corners, overflow hidden. Inside it the same photograph is shown at three distances as the reader scrolls: the whole subject, then scaled to 180% toward one detail, then to 320% on a second detail (transform: scale with a transform-origin per stage, 700ms ease, switched by IntersectionObserver on three invisible markers). The sentence is delivered in halves: its first two or three words sit above the frame at clamp(56px, 8vw, 130px), centred; the last words arrive below the frame at the second stage, overlapping the frame's bottom edge by 0.3em. At the third stage one caption of 28ch at 17px appears to the right of the frame, top-aligned. The two halves together are the heading and stay within two lines.
sections.mobile: The frame grows to 70vw at 4:5 and stays sticky at centre. The first half of the sentence sits above it at 13vw, the second half below it at the same size. The third-stage caption appears under the sentence at 16px, centred.

sections.name: Photographs down a diagonal
sections.blueprint: Three stages, three photographs of different sizes placed along a falling diagonal on the 12-column grid. Stage one: a 3:4 portrait in columns 1–4. Stage two: a 1:1 square in columns 6–8, its top edge 220px lower than the first photograph's top. Stage three: a 16:10 landscape in columns 8–12, starting 180px below the bottom of the second. Each stage's text sits in the gap the stagger leaves: a paragraph of up to 36ch at 17px, top-aligned with its photograph and placed in the columns to its right (to its left for the third). Each paragraph opens with a bold run-in phrase that carries the order: 'On the first day', 'A week later', 'By the end'. Square corners; no arrows or connecting marks. The heading, two to four words at clamp(36px, 4vw, 64px) in a light weight, sits alone in columns 7–12 at the very top, level with the first photograph's top edge.
sections.mobile: The diagonal becomes alternating widths: the first photograph at 100%, the second at 62% flush right, the third at 78% flush left. Each paragraph follows its photograph on that photograph's left edge at 16px. 56px between stages. The heading sits above at 30px.

sections.name: Large questions, answers beside
sections.blueprint: Every answer is open; nothing collapses. Each question-and-answer pair is a row on the 12-column grid: the question in columns 1–6 at clamp(26px, 2.6vw, 40px), medium weight, leading 1.1, no more than two lines; its answer in columns 8–12 at 17–18px with leading 1.55 and a measure near 40ch, its first baseline level with the question's first baseline. Rows are separated by 72–88px of empty space and nothing else. Five to seven rows. The section heading, two or three words, is set at the same size as the questions but in the softer ink and sits as the first row's left cell with an empty right cell, so it reads as the top of the same table rather than a title above it. Because questions are large and answers small, the left column works as a scannable index.
sections.mobile: Each pair stacks: question at 24px, answer 12px beneath at 17px, then 56px of space before the next. The heading leads at the same 24px in the softer ink. Answers stay open; there is no accordion on the phone either.

sections.name: The email as display type
sections.blueprint: The section is 100svh in the inverse of the page's colours. A single email address is set as one line of display type spanning the content width: the font-size is fitted so the address runs from margin to margin (about 7–9vw for 20 characters; break after the @ onto two lines if it is longer than 26), light or regular weight, tight tracking, sitting on a baseline 12vh above the bottom edge. It is a `mailto:` link; on hover the whole line takes the accent ink. In the top-left corner, a sentence of up to 12 words at 20–22px says what to write about. In the two bottom corners at 14px: phone and city at the left, two or three social links at the right. No heading and no form. For a pinned ending, make the section `position: sticky; bottom: 0` beneath the page so the previous section lifts off it.
sections.mobile: The address breaks after the @ onto two lines at 11.5vw, left-aligned, sitting at 55% of an 86svh screen. The sentence sits at the top-left at 18px. Phone, city and social links stack at the bottom-left at 15px with 12px between them.

references.name: Kereliott
references.idea: A quiet house gets a quiet page: one dark field, one typeface, the name set as wide as the screen and photographs left to drift in generous darkness.
references.hero: Very dark green-black field with cream type. A two-line introductory sentence at about 30px sits top-left inside 30px margins; a small cream rectangular button sits top-right. The upper half is otherwise empty. The house name fills the full content width in a flared humanist sans, mixed case, with capitals about 19vw tall, its baseline at roughly 87% of the viewport height. Immediately beneath, separated by a gap of a few pixels, the top sliver of a full-width landscape photograph enters from the bottom edge.
references.type: A single face, Trust, in regular weight: a humanist sans with flared terminals and old-style figures. The wordmark is an oversized graphic; all other text is one size of about 20-30px plus tiny 10px photo captions. Hierarchy is position, not weight.
references.colour: #161c1a #eae8dc #222926 #1f2926 — Cream on green-black from top to bottom with no accent colour. The map is drawn in a tone barely lighter than the ground, so photographs supply all the colour.
references.imagery: Natural-light photos of a stone cottage, garden and deck with square corners, in mixed portrait and landscape crops at differing sizes. One full-width opener, then small images placed singly with tiny captions under the left corner.
references.layout: 30px margins, text held to the left 60% in one size. Photographs are staggered left and right at different widths with large dark gaps between, like pictures passed on a wall. The name and a booking button stay fixed in the top corners.

sections.description: A full-width landscape photograph runs margin to margin directly under the wordmark, followed after a gap by a four-line paragraph in the single text size, left-aligned and spanning about 85% of the width. There is no heading or label; the text simply continues the sentence begun at the top of the page.

After a left-aligned paragraph, a silhouette map of the region sits centre-left, about half the viewport wide, filled in a green only a few percent lighter than the background. Five towns are marked with small ring dots and tiny labels; only the house's town has a solid cream dot. No border, legend or frame.

Photographs are placed one or two per screen in a stagger: a portrait image about 30% wide against the left margin, a larger near-square one starting lower against the right margin, later a landscape image top-right of centre and a smaller one bottom-left. Each has a 10px caption under its left corner. More than half of every screen is empty dark ground.

Two short left-aligned sentences in the standard text size with underlined inline links to booking platforms and an email address, then a small cream certification badge. The footer is a single line at the very bottom: social link left, copyright centre, three underlined utility links right, with a tall empty gap above.

steal: Size the wordmark to fill the content width exactly and let the first photograph tuck directly under its baseline.
Draw a location map as a tone-on-tone silhouette with one filled dot among ring dots.
Use a single typeface in one weight and essentially one text size, creating hierarchy through placement and emptiness.

references.name: Deeo Studio
references.idea: The studio's four letters as huge extruded iridescent 3D blocks tumbling across a black stage, with a quiet ultralight serif statement underneath.
references.hero: Near-black viewport. Four extruded 3D letters, each roughly 45-60% of the viewport tall, are scattered at different depths and tilts across the top 80% of the screen: one cropped by the top-left corner, one lower and left of centre, a larger one upper-right, the last cropped by the right edge. Faces are dark glass; edges catch lilac, orange and holographic rainbow light. Over them runs a slim nav: bold caps wordmark top-left at a 60px margin, three small caps links (one with a tiny yellow tag) and an outlined rounded button top-right. Bottom-left, a light serif headline at about 72px begins and is cut by the fold after two lines.
references.type: PP Editorial New Ultralight for the statement headline at about 5vw; PP Neue Montreal Book, Medium and Bold for nav, caps labels and project titles; Inter 14px body. A bold Neue Montreal line reaches 160px (11.1vw) lower on the page. Light serif against bold grotesk is the pairing.
references.colour: #0d0d0d #ffffff #b79cf0 #ff5a1f #f5f5f5 #f0e68c — Near-black page with white type; colour comes from iridescent lilac, orange and rainbow reflections on the 3D letters and from each case-study thumbnail's own palette. The digest records one light grey section.
references.imagery: Extruded glassy letterforms with holographic edge light on black; case studies as square-cornered wide video thumbnails in each client's colours on a two-column grid; one tilted old snapshot in the footer.
references.layout: Side margins of 60px. After the hero come a small left-aligned paragraph and a caps label, then a work list that opens with one full-width thumbnail and continues as two columns with staggered vertical offsets. Every item repeats the same caption row. The footer is centred.

sections.description: The serif headline finishes just below the fold at top-left. Beneath it sits a four-line 17px grotesk paragraph in a column only about 190px wide (13% of the viewport), left-aligned at the margin, followed by roughly 120px of empty black and a tiny caps section label. The right three-quarters of the screen stay completely empty.

The first project is a single thumbnail running margin to margin; the rest sit in two columns with a 14px gutter, the right column offset vertically so thumbnails never align in rows. Under each thumbnail: project name in 16px medium at left with a line of tiny grey caps disciplines beneath, and a small outlined rounded button right-aligned on the same row. Square image corners, no card containers.

A tilted, slightly warped 1990s snapshot with a year caption overlaps giant block letters of the studio name set in dark grey barely lighter than the background, each letter several hundred pixels tall. Below, a centred row of five small links and a single centred line of the light serif at about 28px with a tiny speaker icon.

steal: Render the studio name as separate 3D letters at different depths and tilts, cropped by the viewport edges, instead of a flat wordmark.
Pair the loud hero object with an ultralight serif statement at bottom-left and a deliberately tiny, narrow paragraph, leaving most of the next screen empty.
Caption every work thumbnail with the same two-ended row: name and disciplines left, small outlined button right.

references.name: Vero New-York
references.idea: Treat a keepsake like couture: a slow close-up film opens, then a white 3D sculpture of a dress stays pinned at centre while one sentence in mixed capitals and italics passes over it.
references.hero: Full-bleed video with no scrim: an extreme close-up of a woman's profile against a burnt-orange wall, a blurred pale sculpture occupying the right 40% of the frame in the foreground. Exactly at centre sits the four-letter wordmark in white serif capitals, about 240px wide; 25px beneath it a one-line tagline at 20px alternates italic lowercase connectives with roman capitals. Two translucent frosted rectangles with square corners float 30px from the top corners: a 130px menu button left, a 250px commission button right, both in small capitals. A tiny chevron marks the bottom centre. Nothing else; the image carries the screen.
references.type: Louize Display at 120px (8.3vw), centred: nouns in roman capitals, connective words in lowercase italic at the same size within the same line. Beausite Classic grotesk appears only for a bold 17px lead and footer links. Serif body runs 11–16px; the footer wordmark fills the width.
references.colour: #f3f0ed #181615 #b4521f #c6a788 #ffffff #97775a — Burnt orange and skin tones in the opening film, then warm off-white pages with near-black type and a plaster-white sculpture; orange returns only inside one small photograph.
references.imagery: Shallow-focus warm video up top; a real-time 3D plaster-white bust and lace dress on off-white, cropped at neck and hem and fading into the page; one small square-cornered photo of the dress on a plinth against orange.
references.layout: Everything sits on one centre axis with wide empty flanks. Two fixed corner buttons persist as soft-shadowed white tiles. Headlines take two lines each and share the screen with the pinned 3D object; body text is confined to a 240px centred column.

sections.description: Off-white screen. The sentence is delivered in halves: first two centred lines at 8.3vw in the upper third, with a small diamond glyph beside the italic word, while a white 3D bust rises from the bottom centre at about 30% of the width. Scrolling turns the sculpture to show the laced back, now filling the full height of the centre column, and the second half of the sentence lands over the skirt in the lower third.

The skirt's hem dissolves into the off-white at the top of the screen. Beneath it is a centred text stack only about 240px wide: a three-line lead in bold grotesk at 17px, four lines of serif body at 11px, and a small white rectangular button with a diffuse shadow carrying the same italic-plus-capitals label as the header button. The lower half of the viewport is left empty.

A tiny centred eyebrow in the italic-plus-capitals style, then a two-line headline at about 8vw where each line begins with a lowercase italic word and ends in capitals, the lines offset so the block reads as a stagger. Under it, centred, one small photo about 330×290px with square corners: saturated orange backdrop, white dress on a plinth. The image is deliberately much smaller than the type.

Off-white. Top-left, a five-item vertical link list in small grotesk; under it a newsletter field drawn as a single underline with an arrow; three social links right-aligned at the same level. Then the wordmark in near-black serif capitals stretches across the full width, about 45% of the viewport tall. A final row of tiny grey legal links sits beneath.

steal: Within one serif headline, set the nouns in roman capitals and the small connective words in lowercase italic at the same size.
Pin a single white 3D object on an off-white page and deliver one sentence in two halves over its front and back as it turns.
Follow a huge two-line headline with one deliberately small, saturated photograph centred beneath it instead of a full-width image.
references.media: A full-bleed 10s studio film covers the whole first screen with no scrim, the wordmark centred on it. Then a fixed render of the dress sculpture that the camera travels down while headlines rise over it, an inset window under a headline that grows to full bleed, a pinned full-bleed stepper with right-to-left wipes, a sticky picture beside parallax pictures, a grid of 4:5 thumbnails in columns at different speeds, and a 3D coin passing through a typographic wall; 0px corners and two strict photo families, brides on burnt orange and white resin on grey.
references.motion: A preloader of about 3.5-4s: a centred serif statement with a small photo window between its lines that opens by clip-path into the hero film over 1.4s cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1), then the wordmark fades in. Native scroll driven by script: the beige page slides up over the fixed hero, a 3840px sticky stepper advances three photographs, and headline words rise out of line masks over 1.2-1.4s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) at 0.1s steps; images clip in over 1.6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1).
